facts.fact: 听到 Max 的尖叫，Caspian 撞开帐帘冲进来，Drakken 持阔剑跟在后面。
facts.anchor: Caspian came through the entrance, broad shoulders filling the gap

facts.fact: Max 回忆 Aelindor 在哭声出口之前就感到了她心里的断裂，用吻驱走噩梦、把她搂进怀里。
facts.anchor: He’d felt the fracture in me before it became a sound

facts.fact: Drakken 进帐就吼，要求战况汇报，还威胁说这最好不是又一次「求关注」。
facts.anchor: This had better not be another bid for attention!

facts.fact: Max 在 Aelindor 帐中恐慌发作：铁箍勒胸、喘不上气，帐壁仿佛向内收缩。
facts.anchor: a band of iron cinching around my chest, squeezing the air out in thin, useless gasps

facts.fact: Aelindor 对着 Max 的嘴渡气，把他的空气与镇定灌进她不肯工作的肺里。
facts.anchor: This was deliberate as he pressed his mouth to mine and breathed into me

facts.fact: Max 体内的 demon passenger 在整个幻象期间一言不发，像掠食者一样静观计算，随后喝令她振作。
facts.anchor: It’d been observing quietly, calculating like a predator.

facts.fact: Max 回想继承人间的争斗史：她在医务室半死不活时，Caspian 和 Nikolai 为谁给她端杯子吵过。
facts.anchor: I’d seen Caspian and Nikolai bicker over who got to hold the cup for me when I was half-dead in the infirmary.

facts.fact: Max 观察到关键差异：Aelindor 在场时竞争没有消失，但转成了纪律，没人挑战他。
facts.anchor: When Aelindor was in the room, even though the competition didn’t vanish, it shifted into discipline.
